clientFunction.name: get_monthly_trend
clientFunction.description: Return a 3-month spending trend (most-recent first), with a precomputed delta vs last month. THIS IS THE CANONICAL TREND SOURCE — never compute month-on-month deltas in your head; always call this tool. Optionally scoped to a single category OR a single vendor (mutually exclusive). Pass show=true when the customer wants to SEE the trend chart ("how am I trending?", "how is Costa trending?"): the app navigates to spending and surfaces the monthly-trend view scoped to the same category/vendor. Returns { scope:'overall'|'category'|'vendor', matched_vendors?:[…], months:[{label,total}], delta_vs_last_month }.

category.description: Optional. Scope the trend to a single category. Mutually exclusive with `vendor`.

vendor.description: Optional. Scope the trend to a single vendor (case-insensitive substring match). Mutually exclusive with `category`.

show.description: Optional. When true, the app also navigates to the spending page and surfaces the monthly-trend view scoped to the same category/vendor. Use when the customer asked to SEE the trend; omit (or false) for pure data lookups.
